stages.P2: First impression and preference before use

levers.evidence: Real answers from other people to the same or related questions
levers.prior: Base rates the model cannot know: tie and neutral shares, scale use, outcome rates
levers.context: Facts about the products given to the model (ratings, listings, reviews)
levers.calibration: Labels used to fit spread, tie share or bias corrections
levers.training: Corpus for fine-tuning a judge, reader or behaviour model
levers.profiles: Person-level histories used to build reasons and segments
levers.outcomes: Ground truth to score forecasts on (ledgers, live launches)

tiers.FREE: Public data or our own compute (GCP and model calls not counted)
tiers.EXPERIMENTAL: About $200 a month: small paid pilots to find which direction pays
tiers.INCREMENTAL: About $2,000 a month: scale the directions that proved out

sources.name: A person's earlier answers (profiles)

P1.why: Twin-2K: reasons axes beat demographics for individuals and for group gaps
